routes.label_vi: Tạo object và đưa vào collection
routes.summary: Create an object in the database using a data-block, or None for an empty; linking it to a collection is a separate API operation.
routes.choose_when: Assemble objects or empties and specify the collection that contains them.
do_not_assume: BlendDataObjects.new only creates the database object; use CollectionObjects.link to add it to a collection.

evidence.supports: Create a database object; object_data can be None for an empty.
Add an object to a collection.

routes.label_vi: Biến đổi không gian và quan hệ cha con
routes.summary: Object exposes a world-space transformation matrix and a reference to its parent object.
routes.choose_when: Set spatial transforms or establish object parenting.
do_not_assume: The parent description identifies the parent object; it does not establish how to preserve the world transform when changing parents.

evidence.supports: matrix_world is the world-space transformation matrix.
parent references the parent object.

routes.label_vi: Instance collection hoặc object con
routes.summary: An Object can instance an existing collection or instance child objects on vertices or faces.
routes.choose_when: Use Object instancing with an existing collection or parent-child object relationship.

evidence.supports: instance_collection uses an existing collection.
VERTS and FACES instance child objects on vertices or faces; COLLECTION enables collection instancing.

routes.label_vi: Đọc hình học đã tính animation, constraint và modifier
routes.summary: The dependency graph exposes evaluated animation, constraints and modifiers; to_mesh creates a temporary mesh owned by the object.
routes.choose_when: Measure, inspect or retrieve evaluated geometry rather than only the original data.
do_not_assume: ID.evaluated_get returns the last evaluation result; it does not guarantee that the graph has been evaluated.
Object.to_mesh creates temporary data that requires to_mesh_clear; do not link it directly to an object in the main database.

evidence.supports: The Evaluated ID example describes animation, constraints and modifiers in evaluated state.
Return the ID from the last evaluation without guaranteeing graph re-evaluation.
Create a temporary mesh owned by the object and release it with to_mesh_clear.

routes.label_vi: Tạo mesh từ danh sách đỉnh, cạnh và mặt
routes.label_en: Mesh from explicit vertices edges and faces
routes.summary: Mesh.from_pydata accepts vertex coordinates and edge/face indices; an empty edge list causes edges to be inferred from polygons.
routes.choose_when: The output can be specified as coordinates and geometry connections.
do_not_assume: from_pydata does not prevent invalid mesh data; the source calls for validation when input validity is not guaranteed.

evidence.supports: Create a mesh from vertices, edges and faces; infer missing edges from polygons; warn about invalid data.
validate returns True if invalid data was corrected or removed.

routes.label_vi: Sửa topology qua BMesh
intent_aliases: chỉnh liên kết đỉnh cạnh mặt
routes.summary: BMesh exposes geometry connectivity and mesh editing operations such as split, separate, collapse and dissolve.
routes.choose_when: Edit connectivity flexibly rather than only construct mesh storage arrays.
do_not_assume: bmesh.from_edit_mesh requires a mesh already in Edit Mode; obj.data may not be synchronized with Edit Mode.
The BMesh page states that Disk/Radial data is not exposed to Python.

evidence.supports: The introduction describes connectivity and split/separate/collapse/dissolve editing; Disk/Radial data is not exposed.
Retrieve the BMesh of a mesh in Edit Mode.
Edit Mode has separate data and obj.data may be out of sync.

routes.label_vi: Extrude một vùng mặt
routes.summary: BMesh extrude_face_region creates extruded geometry from input edges/faces and returns geometry; it does not transform positions itself.
routes.choose_when: Create extruded geometry from a selected BMesh region.
do_not_assume: The source explicitly states that extrude_face_region does not transform; displacement requires a separately documented transformation operation.

evidence.supports: Extrude faces without transformation; accept edges/faces and return geom.

routes.label_vi: Cắt mesh bằng mặt phẳng
routes.summary: BMesh bisect_plane cuts a mesh using a plane point and normal, with options to remove either side.
routes.choose_when: Specify a cutting plane and the side to keep or remove.
do_not_assume: The bisect_plane description does not promise to cap the cut automatically.

evidence.supports: Cut a mesh with a plane; document plane_co, plane_no and clear_outer/clear_inner.

routes.label_vi: Gộp đỉnh gần nhau và tam giác hóa
routes.label_en: Weld nearby vertices and triangulate faces
routes.summary: remove_doubles merges groups of vertices within a distance threshold; triangulate splits quads and n-gons into triangles.
routes.choose_when: Merge nearby vertices or convert faces into triangles using the documented topology operations.
do_not_assume: Mesh.calc_loop_triangles computes tessellation; this is not the same as changing topology with bmesh.ops.triangulate.

evidence.supports: Find and merge vertex groups closer than dist.
Split quads and n-gons into triangles.
Compute loop triangle tessellation.

routes.label_vi: Lưu thuộc tính trên phần tử hình học
routes.label_en: Geometry attributes by name type and domain
routes.summary: An Attribute stores data attached to geometry elements, with a name, data type and domain such as points, curves or faces.
routes.choose_when: Store typed data on a geometry domain for later reading or processing.
do_not_assume: Name, type and domain are separate properties; do not infer a domain solely from vertex count.

evidence.supports: Explain geometry attributes, unique names, types and domains.
Add an attribute with name, type and domain.

routes.label_vi: Giao, hợp và trừ mesh bằng Boolean modifier
routes.summary: The Boolean modifier supports intersection, union and difference of meshes; a collection can supply operand meshes.
routes.choose_when: Represent mesh intersection, union or subtraction as a modifier.

evidence.supports: INTERSECT keeps common geometry; UNION combines additively; DIFFERENCE subtracts.
collection supplies mesh objects for the Boolean operation.

routes.label_vi: Bo tròn cạnh hoặc đỉnh
routes.summary: BevelModifier rounds edges/vertices; bmesh.ops.bevel operates on geometry with offset, segments and profile.
routes.choose_when: Round edges/vertices; select the modifier route to retain a modifier, or BMesh when editing topology directly.

evidence.supports: The modifier rounds edges and vertices.
Bevel edges/vertices with offset, segments and profile; profile 0.5 is described as round.

routes.label_vi: Nhân hình học thành dãy
routes.summary: ArrayModifier duplicates geometry with a copy count, constant offset and a curve for fitting array length.
routes.choose_when: Create an array controlled by modifier count and spacing.

evidence.supports: Describe array duplication, count, constant_offset_displace and a curve for fitting length.

routes.label_vi: Đối xứng hình học
routes.summary: MirrorModifier exposes mirroring axes, a reference object and a merge distance for mirrored vertices.
routes.choose_when: Mirror geometry across axes or relative to a reference object using a modifier.

evidence.supports: Describe mirroring, mirror_object and the vertex merge threshold.
An array of three flags enables mirroring by axis.

routes.label_vi: Tạo vỏ có độ dày
routes.summary: SolidifyModifier creates a solid skin; thickness controls its shell thickness.
routes.choose_when: Create a shell with thickness from input geometry.

evidence.supports: Create a solid skin and compensate for sharp angles.
thickness sets shell thickness.

routes.label_vi: Chia nhỏ bề mặt, có hoặc không làm cong
routes.summary: SubsurfModifier provides Catmull-Clark for smooth curved surfaces and Simple for subdividing faces without changing shape.
routes.choose_when: Increase surface subdivisions and explicitly choose whether to curve the surface.

evidence.supports: CATMULL_CLARK creates a smooth curved surface; SIMPLE subdivides without changing shape.

routes.label_vi: Tái tạo bề mặt với topology đều
routes.summary: RemeshModifier generates a new surface with regular topology following the input mesh; adaptivity reduces detail where less is needed and creates triangles.
routes.choose_when: Replace surface topology with a new mesh following the input shape.
do_not_assume: The source says adaptivity can create triangles; it does not promise all-quad output.

evidence.supports: Generate regular surface topology from an input mesh; adaptivity creates triangles when simplifying.

routes.label_vi: Giảm số mặt hình học
routes.summary: DecimateModifier offers edge collapse, un-subdivision and planar dissolve; ratio controls the target triangle ratio for collapse.
routes.choose_when: Reduce geometry with a documented decimation method.
do_not_assume: The source limits ratio to collapse; do not use it as a common control for every decimate_type.

evidence.supports: Describe COLLAPSE, UNSUBDIV and DISSOLVE.
Target triangle ratio applies only to collapse.

routes.label_vi: Áp hình học vào object mục tiêu
routes.summary: ShrinkwrapModifier wraps an object onto a target, with an auxiliary target and cull_face controls for projection based on face orientation.
routes.choose_when: Make geometry follow a target mesh through shrink wrapping.
do_not_assume: The shrinkwrap description does not establish a complete automatic retopology workflow.

evidence.supports: Describe wrapping to a target, auxiliary_target and cull_face.

routes.label_vi: Dựng graph Geometry Nodes
routes.summary: GeometryNodeTree holds linked geometry nodes; NodesModifier.node_group references the graph driving the modifier.
routes.choose_when: Create a geometry graph or a modifier driven by a node group; select specific node routes for processing operations.
do_not_assume: Nodes.new requires node.bl_idname, not node.type.
NodeTreeInterface.new_socket lists only DEFAULT for socket_type; this page does not establish all runtime socket types.

evidence.supports: A node tree contains linked nodes for geometry.
A node group controls the modifier.
Create a node using bl_idname; the source warns against node.type.
Create an interface socket; socket_type is listed as DEFAULT.

routes.label_vi: Rải điểm trên bề mặt và instance hình học
intent_aliases: phân bố vật thể trên mặt
routes.summary: DistributePointsOnFaces generates points on mesh surfaces; InstanceOnPoints creates geometry references at points without duplicating underlying data.
routes.choose_when: Distribute geometry instances over a surface; trees or rocks describe user-supplied content, not assets generated by these nodes.
do_not_assume: These nodes do not supply tree or rock models; they describe point distribution and geometry references.

evidence.supports: Generate points scattered on a mesh surface with RANDOM or POISSON distribution.
Generate geometry references at each point without duplicating underlying data.

routes.label_vi: Chuyển instance thành dữ liệu hình học
intent_aliases: chuyển instance thành hình học thật
routes.summary: RealizeInstances converts instances into real geometry data.
routes.choose_when: The input contains instances and a later step requires geometry data instead of instance references.
do_not_assume: The source says geometry data; it does not claim every input type becomes a mesh.
realize_to_point_domain is documented as compatibility behavior for version 5.0 and earlier.

evidence.supports: Convert instances to real geometry data; describe realize_to_point_domain as legacy compatibility.

routes.label_vi: Đọc/ghi thuộc tính có tên trong graph
routes.label_en: Named attribute field storage and retrieval
routes.summary: StoreNamedAttribute stores a field result on geometry under a name; InputNamedAttribute reads the specified attribute.
routes.choose_when: Exchange geometry data through named attributes in a node graph, with source-supported types and domains.

evidence.supports: Store a field result under a name with data_type and domain.
Retrieve a specified attribute with data_type.

routes.label_vi: Bắn tia lấy thông tin điểm chạm hình học
routes.summary: GeometryNodeRaycast casts rays from context geometry toward target geometry and retrieves hit information.
routes.choose_when: Compute ray/geometry hit information in a Geometry Nodes graph.
do_not_assume: This describes a geometry query, not renderer shadow configuration.

evidence.supports: Cast rays from context geometry to target geometry and retrieve hit-point information.

routes.label_vi: Dữ liệu và cặp node simulation zone
routes.summary: SimulationInput/Output pass data into and out of a simulation zone; pair_with_output pairs the nodes and reports success.
routes.choose_when: A simulation zone is required and the task needs the node pairing and state-data APIs.
do_not_assume: These pages describe node pairing and state items; they do not provide simulation equations or a complete evaluation/baking workflow for a particular effect.

evidence.supports: Describe simulation zone input and paired_output.
Describe simulation zone output and state_items.
Pair a zone input with an output and return a success boolean.

routes.label_vi: Đường cong, spline và hình học có tiết diện
routes.summary: Curve stores curves, splines and NURBS; create POLY, BEZIER or NURBS splines and set bevel radius and extrusion along local Z.
routes.choose_when: Describe geometry as splines and use Curve bevel/extrusion properties.
do_not_assume: bevel_depth excludes extrusion; the source defines extrude along local Z, along the curve and perpendicular to its normals.

evidence.supports: A Curve data-block stores curves, splines and NURBS.
Add a POLY, BEZIER or NURBS spline.
Bevel radius excludes extrusion.
Add depth along local Z, along the curve and perpendicular to normals.

routes.label_vi: Chữ dưới dạng hình học curve
routes.summary: TextCurve stores text in a curve data-block, with body holding the text; StringToCurves generates a paragraph with a font and stores each character as a curve instance.
routes.choose_when: Create text geometry or curve instances in Geometry Nodes.
do_not_assume: These sources describe text geometry; they do not establish sequencer titles or screen font drawing.

evidence.supports: A curve data-block stores text.
body holds the text object's content.
Generate a paragraph with a font, storing each character as a curve instance.

routes.label_vi: Dữ liệu hair curves
routes.summary: Curves is a hair-curves data-block with geometry attributes; add_curves accepts a point count for each curve.
routes.choose_when: Create hair-curves data with specified point counts per curve.
do_not_assume: add_curves only describes curve sizes; it does not establish a complete grooming or hairstyle workflow.

evidence.supports: A hair-curves data-block exposes geometry attributes.
sizes specifies the number of points in each curve.

routes.label_vi: Volume grids và chuyển đổi mesh/volume
routes.label_en: Volume grids mesh to volume and volume to mesh
routes.summary: Volume stores 3D grids; MeshToVolume creates fog volume from a mesh surface and VolumeToMesh creates a surface mesh from volume. VolumeGrids.load reads grid lists and metadata from a file.
routes.choose_when: Use volume grids or a documented mesh/volume conversion.
do_not_assume: VolumeGrids.load only promises grid lists and metadata; success does not prove all voxels are loaded or the volume renders correctly.

evidence.supports: A Volume data-block stores 3D volume grids.
Load grid lists and metadata from a file and return a success boolean.
Create fog volume following an input mesh surface.
Create a mesh on a volume surface.

routes.label_vi: Point cloud có vị trí và bán kính
routes.summary: PointCloud is a point-cloud data-block; GeometryNodePoints generates points with positions and radii defined by fields.
routes.choose_when: Create points with position/radius data rather than mesh faces.
do_not_assume: PointCloud.points is documented as a read-only collection; do not infer an add_points method on the data-block.

evidence.supports: A point-cloud data-block exposes geometry attributes.
Generate a point cloud with positions and radii defined by fields.
points is a read-only collection in this snapshot.

routes.label_vi: Bề mặt dạng khối mềm bằng Metaball
routes.summary: MetaBall defines blobby surfaces and contains MetaElement items.
routes.choose_when: Use the documented blobby surface type and continue selecting its elements through the API.
do_not_assume: A blobby surface description does not establish fluid or soft-body simulation.

evidence.supports: A metaball data-block defines blobby surfaces.
A collection contains metaball elements.

routes.label_vi: Tạo UV layer và đọc/ghi tọa độ góc mặt
routes.label_en: UV layers and face corner coordinates
routes.summary: UVLoopLayers.new adds a UV map; MeshUVLoopLayer.uv holds face-corner UV coordinates associated with mesh loops.
routes.choose_when: Assign known UV coordinates by face corner, or create/inspect a UV layer directly.
do_not_assume: UVs belong to face corners; do not assume one UV per vertex without supporting evidence.
A read-only uv collection does not mean every contained Float2AttributeValue is immutable; read the value type.

evidence.supports: Add a UV map layer to a Mesh.
Face-corner UV coordinates form a Float2AttributeValue collection.
Polygons reference loops; corner data such as UVs is attached to loops.

routes.label_vi: Unwrap mesh hoặc chiếu UV các mặt đã chọn
routes.summary: uv.unwrap unwraps the mesh being edited; smart_project projection-unwraps selected faces with angle_limit and island spacing.
routes.choose_when: Have Blender compute UVs from a mesh or selected faces instead of supplying coordinates.
do_not_assume: unwrap refers to an object being edited and smart_project to selected faces; these operators depend on context and can fail poll.

evidence.supports: Unwrap the mesh object being edited with the listed methods.
Projection-unwrap selected mesh faces; angle_limit controls projection grouping/distortion.
Operators use context and can fail poll.

routes.label_vi: Xếp UV islands trong UV/UDIM space
routes.label_en: Pack UV islands into UV or UDIM space
routes.summary: pack_islands transforms UV islands to fill UV/UDIM space, with rotation, scale, margin and packing-target options.
routes.choose_when: Existing UV islands need arrangement in UV or UDIM space.
do_not_assume: pack_islands transforms islands; it does not prove that the mesh has been unwrapped.
This operator depends on context as described in the operator guide.

evidence.supports: Transform islands to fill UV/UDIM space; describe rotate, scale, margin and udim_source.
Operators obtain their targets from context.

routes.label_vi: Lọc biến dạng mesh khi sculpt
routes.summary: sculpt.mesh_filter modifies the current mesh with filters including smooth, inflate, sphere, random, volume-preserving surface smooth, sharpen and enhance details.
routes.choose_when: Apply a sculpt filter whose documented effect matches the intended change.
do_not_assume: The API does not confirm operation in every background context; the operator guide requires context/poll checks.

evidence.supports: Apply a filter to the current mesh; list and describe filter types.
Operators use context and can fail poll.

routes.label_vi: Lọc mask và tạo face set trong sculpt
routes.label_en: Sculpt mask filters and face sets
routes.summary: mask_filter smooths, sharpens, grows, shrinks or changes mask contrast; face_sets_create creates face sets from a mask, visible region, whole mesh or Edit Mode selection.
routes.choose_when: Adjust a mask or group faces from an existing selection source.
do_not_assume: Masks and face sets are different outputs; select the operation matching the requested output.
Both APIs are operators and require a valid context.

evidence.supports: Filter the current mask with listed filter_type values.
Create face sets from masked, visible, all or selected faces.
Operators use context.

routes.label_vi: Áp nét cọ sculpt lên geometry
routes.summary: sculpt.brush_stroke applies a geometry stroke using OperatorStrokeElement data, normal/invert mode, brush toggle and pen flip.
routes.choose_when: The task requires brush strokes and can supply stroke data with an appropriate context.
do_not_assume: The page describes stroke and mouse_event but does not provide an editor-context setup for background CLI use.

evidence.supports: Apply a sculpt stroke using OperatorStrokeElement; override_location can be recomputed from mouse_event.
Operators obtain their working data from context.

routes.label_vi: Gán trọng số vertex group
routes.summary: VertexGroup.add assigns weights to vertex indices with replace/add/subtract modes; paint.weight_set fills the active group with the current paint weight.
routes.choose_when: Use VertexGroup.add for explicit indexed weights; inspect weight_set to fill the active group using the current paint weight.
do_not_assume: VertexGroup.add does not infer appropriate weights; weight_set uses the active group and current paint weight.

evidence.supports: Add vertices by index with weight 0..1 and REPLACE/ADD/SUBTRACT.
Fill the active vertex group with the current paint weight.

routes.label_vi: Tô màu toàn lớp vertex color hiện hành
routes.summary: paint.vertex_color_set fills the active vertex color layer using the current paint color; use_alpha selects opaque or existing alpha.
routes.choose_when: Fill the active color layer with the paint color and choose alpha handling.
do_not_assume: The source only describes the active layer and current paint color; it does not establish layer creation or render material setup.

evidence.supports: Fill the active vertex color layer; use_alpha selects opaque alpha or preserves existing alpha.
The operator works through context.

routes.label_vi: Vẽ nét cọ vào ảnh
routes.summary: paint.image_paint paints a stroke into an image using OperatorStrokeElement data, normal/invert mode, brush toggle and pen flip.
routes.choose_when: Apply an image paint stroke with specified stroke data and context.
do_not_assume: The operator page does not provide a complete background CLI paint context; it does not establish that stroke data alone is sufficient.

evidence.supports: Paint a stroke into an image with stroke, mode, brush_toggle and pen_flip.
Operators use context and can fail poll.
